not_approved: No native implementation, numeric balance, world unlock schedule, actor deployment cap, or owner art selection asserted.
shared: World1 planning in a 10-world,50-local-level-each direction. Equipment appearance milestones are not every world level.
Retain family identity, shared stylized winter blue/orange timber/stone metal material language and selected conveyor/resource unit scale.
New functional tier footprints and ports may expand; clearance and route migration must be authored before native adoption.
Base competence remains useful. Upgrades must show visible working hardware and operational differences beyond recolor/brackets.

sawmill.baseline: Selected compact single-log hand-crank circular saw station, existing one-at-a-time cutting and reachable pickup.
sawmill.upgrade_a: Buffered roller-feed mill: structural bed extension, a real log feed rack and metering gate, rollers leading into a guarded cutting head, separate downstream plank collection rack. Existing manual loading stays possible.
sawmill.upgrade_b: Parallel sawmill: substantially larger open-sided blue-roofed timber/steel mill, two distinct fed cutting lanes with separate guarded heads and output lanes, larger raw waiting racks, downstream plank staging. No input-to-output bypass; outputs remain planks, not free extra recipe yields.
sawmill.value: Less repeated loading downtime in A. Two eligible jobs can use genuinely separate work stations in B; effective throughput still depends on available raw wood, operating resources, labor/drive and downstream clearance.
sawmill.use_states: Show actual log contact with roller feed and cutting line, plank output, reachable manual service lane. Full output blocks admission without destroying or duplicating queued/committed stock.
sawmill.numeric_status: Exact throughput, capacity, yield, cost and level binding remain to be tuned and proven; do not print multipliers.
sawmill.drive_contract: Upgrade A retains an accessible manual crank with a visibly linked roller feed and cutting drive. Upgrade B proposes two independently staffed crank/work stations; each crew operator drives one lane, which can also be worked manually. Both lanes running requires two actual eligible workers/operators. This proposal does not invent a grid or free autonomous power source.
sawmill.blocked_lane_contract: Full output holds admission/drive for the affected lane only, retaining its queued and committed stock; the other independently clear staffed lane may continue. No bypass or duplicated yield.

storage_house.baseline: Selected enclosed orange timber, blue gable roof, crate emblem and sliding blue doors; existing typed shelves, clear center aisle, right-side separated fuel bay/hatch. Typed organization and mixed storage already exist.
storage_house.upgrade_a: Receiving-and-dispatch warehouse: add covered lateral receiving dock and separate dispatch hatch with accessible apron, expanded reachable shelving. Original central gable and pedestrian door remain recognizable. At least two distinct service approaches let inbound and outbound jobs avoid one bottleneck.
storage_house.upgrade_b: Protected logistics hall: larger connected gable wings, masonry lower walls, armored working doors and covered loading gantry; separate inbound buffer, actual typed stock bays, reserved outbound staging and clear worker circulation. Fuel stays in a separately accessed side compartment. Inputs and outputs are the same stored resource types.
storage_house.value: A separates arrival and pickup work. B handles more concurrent receiving, staged outgoing jobs and protected stock while retaining accountable physical ownership; material capacity is only claimed if implemented as authored bounded storage. No extra survivor carry capacity or manufactured goods.
storage_house.use_states: Whole building exterior and coherent roof-off interior/working state with continuous ingress, worker lane and dispatch path; sources must be actual bays, not teleport icons. Closed doors/shelter shown separately from cutaway. Same unit scale goods and standard-width conveyor dock where authored.
storage_house.numeric_status: Exact storage limits, handling rates, reserved job count, upgrade bills, footprint dimensions and level binding remain unapproved.
storage_house.ownership_contract: One conserved stock ledger. Inbound unaccepted cargo remains with its original owner until admission commits; stored owned stock may be reserved to a real outgoing job; actual dispatch transfers ownership once. Cancellation releases an unused reservation or returns uncommitted escrow to its existing owner. No duplicate stock in receiving, shelves and dispatch.
storage_house.vehicle_boundary: These are worker/manual/conveyor loading proposals. Garage-first truck ownership/deposit rules remain separate. Warehouse art must not promise direct truck unloading, settle partial-vs-whole unloading conflict VC01 or create a second garage.
storage_house.view_requirement: Show a continuous central pedestrian aisle from the original front door to every reachable work bay in a roof-off opposite-angle working state, with material receiving/dispatch lanes beside it rather than through it.

pre_generation_review.result: Credible purchase reasons; two concrete corrections applied for independent lane drive and single-ledger storage/garage boundaries. Static render review still required.
